description: PNP-009 counter limits. A sender key chain carries MAX_SENDER_CHAIN_LENGTH = 2^16 messages (§5.9): chain indexes run from 0 to 2^16 - 1, in a SenderKeyMessage and in a SenderKeyDistribution. A group version is at most MAX_GROUP_VERSION = 2^53 - 1 (§6.4). Versions are decimal strings: some are not exact as JSON numbers.
